label: Act is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 to POTENCY_2 at a first being
paraphrase: Open premise, analyst formulation, unattributed: whatever first being (no being other than it is simply prior to it) is in potency in a respect is simply posterior to some being in act in that respect. The instance at first beings of act priority for the independent potency parameter (the same body as STMT-ACT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-TO-POTENCY on the independently supplied InPotency). It says nothing about a being to which another is simply prior. Given same-respect non-overlap it is equivalent to STMT-FIRST-BEING-IS-IN-NO-WAY-IN-POTENCY.
